title: Find the Distance Value Between Two Arrays
summary: Determine the count of elements in arr1 for which no element in arr2 is within d units of distance.
statement: Determine the count of elements in arr1 for which no element in arr2 is within d units of distance.
constraints: Count arr1 values whose distance from every arr2 value is greater than d.
reference_solution:
def array_distance_value(arr1, arr2, d):
 return sum(all(abs(x-y)>d for y in arr2) for x in arr1)
hints: Each arr1 value qualifies only if no arr2 value lies in its closed d-neighborhood.
For direct validation, compare it to every arr2 value; a sorted arr2 can use binary search.
Count values whose every absolute difference is greater than d.
The universal comparison matches the definition exactly.
editorial: The universal comparison matches the definition exactly.

Two arr1 values satisfy the strict distance condition.
